For row8-9, I'm tracking three separate objects (the horizontal triple, the vertical pair, and the lone cell) and trying to figure out how their original horizontal order determines their final resting columns, though the pair seems to end up further right than expected.

Checking against example 3 confirms this pattern: pieces slide left row-by-row, blocked by whatever already landed in that row, with the vertical line settling into whatever gap remains after the singles have moved. Now I need to apply this left-gravity-with-collision rule to the actual test input.
